Train Cancellations Leave Passengers Questioning Ticket Refunds

Numerous trains were cancelled on October 10, impacting passengers who had booked tickets and are now seeking refunds. The cancellations are linked to a protest by the 'Cockroach Janata Party' in Delhi, which disrupted rail traffic. Passengers are inquiring about the rules for obtaining refunds for their cancelled tickets, including those booked under Tatkal schemes. The disruption has also reportedly benefited airlines.
